title: It would be great to add error texts into the text_input
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [X] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

Hi Team,

It would be great if we would have a error text field into the text_input, like I am creating a big application with streamlit in which i have a form, I want to validate input of my users and the set a error message accordingly in the text_input.

We can just add a field error_message in the text_input which will show a small beautiful message below the input.

Thanks

Regards,
Dilip Thakkar

### Why?

Because It would be very helpful to create a large form with input validations.

### How?

We can just add a field error_message in the text_input which will show a small beautiful message below the input.

_No response_

## Update

`st.text_input` now supports client-side regex validation with a custom error message through the new `validate` parameter. This will be available in Streamlit `1.62+`.

```python
email = st.text_input(
    "Email",
    validate=(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$", "Enter a valid email address."),
)
```

Invalid non-empty values are not submitted, and the custom message is shown when validation fails.
